''See also: [[Starhammer Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Starhammer is an android and a former protector of the [[Free Worlds]] who has served as a guardian for Mell D-One-Twenty-Five{{!}}Mell. Physically, he resembles a muscular human with black hair, blue eyes, and pale skin, though he possesses inhuman eyes and lacks a biological brain. He has been seen wearing either an [[Advocate]] suit or a white, skintight outfit featuring purple accents and a seven-pointed star symbol. Starhammer is also the captain of the The Zenith Starship{{!}}Zenith Starship known as [[The Last Horizon]]. Throughout his history, Starhammer has been a complex and controversial figure. While he has acted as a protector, he has also been described as a psychopathic killer who deliberately provoked galactic threats—such as the [[Iron King]] and the [[D’Niss]]—to eliminate them. He has led fleets with the support of the [[Galactic Union]] and the [[Karoshan Alliance]] to hunt targets, once even killing a previous version of his adversary. His philosophy involves maintaining peace by removing individuals he deems a threat to the galaxy. In combat, he has utilized [[optical beams]] and possesses enough strength to punch through starship shields. His history includes significant physical trauma, including a ruptured [[power core]] and various severe injuries sustained during conflict.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Starhammer is a broad, muscular android with pale skin, black hair, and blue eyes that can glow bright white. He wears a white skintight outfit with purple accents, a signature gold cape, and a suit featuring a glowing symbol on his chest. Damage to his face reveals mechanical parts, and he possesses a scarlet-edged wound in his chest.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|As the leader of [[the Advocates]] and a member of their High [[Council]], Starhammer is a protector and guardian of the [[Free Worlds]] driven by a primary directive to protect everyone, especially Mell D-One-Twenty-Five{{!}}Mell. While he is described as a hero who carries star-cruisers to safety, he has also been known to experience madness and once made a bid to take over the universe. His mind and personality can shift when his [[Evolution Engine]] activates, though he is also noted to wear his emotions on his sleeve.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Starhammer possesses an evolving [[Aethertech body]] equipped with an [[Evolution Engine]], a [[Subspace Drive]], and a [[Zenith Device]]. He can activate a [[Temporal Field]] to slow the world around him, fly or hover, and fire [[optical beams]] from his eyes. Additionally, he has the power to see through objects, scan individuals through masks, and utilizes flawless magic countermeasures against [[Archmagi]].}}

{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|A hero known for carrying damaged star-cruisers to safety, Starhammer felt an overwhelming sense of relief when he discovered [[Leilari]] was [[safe]].<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c1">''The Engineer'', chapter 1</ref> Mentioned by Mell D-One-Twenty-Five{{!}}Mell, this High [[Council]] member of [[the Advocates]] is an entity who may potentially reach her.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c6">''The Engineer'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c8">''The Engineer'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c9">''The Engineer'', chapter 9</ref> Starhammer possesses the ability to activate a [[Temporal Field]] to slow his surroundings, and he is a powerful figure who once crushed an astral [[dragon]] with a single blow.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c8" /><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c10">''The Engineer'', chapter 10</ref> Having once attempted to take over the universe, he is a man whose wife was saved by the [[Lagomorph Contract]].<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c10" /><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c12">''The Engineer'', chapter 12</ref> He maintains [[Archmage]]-level protection against detection spells and possesses a muscular physique with a chiseled jawline.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c12" /><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c13">''The Engineer'', chapter 13</ref> As the guardian and protector of the [[Free Worlds]], he can fly at top speed, hover, and see through objects.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c14">''The Engineer'', chapter 14</ref> His abilities also include firing [[optical beams]] from his eyes and scanning individuals through their masks.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c14" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Android with Evolution Engine}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Starhammer is a robot created by Mell D-One-Twenty-Five{{!}}Mell to ensure she would never be forgotten.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c20">''The Engineer'', chapter 20</ref> Having previously fought Varic Vallenar{{!}}Varic, this powerful individual possesses flawless magic countermeasures against [[Archmagi]] and exerts a presence akin to being hunted by a [[World Spirit]].<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c21">''The Engineer'', chapter 21</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c23">''The Engineer'', chapter 23</ref> The entity is a real threat who is stronger than the narrator dared to imagine, having once killed the narrator.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c24">''The Engineer'', chapter 24</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c25">''The Engineer'', chapter 25</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c28">''The Engineer'', chapter 28</ref> Associated with the [[Advocate]] organization, Starhammer possesses an internal [[Drive]] and has received massive upgrades.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c27">''The Engineer'', chapter 27</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c29">''The Engineer'', chapter 29</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c30">''The Engineer'', chapter 30</ref> As an android equipped with an [[Evolution Engine]], Starhammer wears a signature gold cape and serves as an exception to most rules.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c31">''The Engineer'', chapter 31</ref> Despite this power, Starhammer has not made any moves to expand his territory.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c32">''The Engineer'', chapter 32</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Commander of the fleet}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|As a leader of a superior fleet, Starhammer learned of the [[Iron Legion]]'s encounter with [[The Last Horizon]] and may arrive with ships from either the Alliance or the [[Union]].<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c33">''The Engineer'', chapter 33</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c34">''The Engineer'', chapter 34</ref> During the conflict, he acted as a commander issuing orders to his vessels.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c35">''The Engineer'', chapter 35</ref> His physical form is characterized by a skintight shield that normally coats his skin, a [[processor implant]], and pain responses that are more muted than those of a human.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c36">''The Engineer'', chapter 36</ref> After killing a [[Lichborn woman]] in powered armor and being warped by the [[Temporal Field]], he remains driven by a primary directive to protect everyone, specifically Mell D-One-Twenty-Five{{!}}Mell.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c37">''The Engineer'', chapter 37</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c39">''The Engineer'', chapter 39</ref> The [[Evolution Engine]] has activated six times, causing his mind and personality to shift while making his thoughts faster and cleaner.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c40">''The Engineer'', chapter 40</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c45">''The Engineer'', chapter 45</ref> This blue-eyed individual is a very strong man who killed [[Clockworker]] by punching through him.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c40" /><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c44">''The Engineer'', chapter 44</ref> A target that the protagonists intend to catch, he is an [[Advocate]] who has addressed mass meetings of his peers.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c41">''The Engineer'', chapter 41</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c42">''The Engineer'', chapter 42</ref> [[Undermaker]] has called the broad, muscular, pale-skinned man with black hair, who hovers slightly above the floor while wearing a golden cape and a suit featuring a glowing 'A' on his chest.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c44" /><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c46">''The Engineer'', chapter 46</ref> Possessing an evolving [[Aethertech body]] and access to a [[Zenith Device]], he is also difficult to affect with magic.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c45" /><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c46" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Nova-Bot combatant}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Starhammer is an emotional android with synthetic [[blood]].<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c46" /><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c47">''The Engineer'', chapter 47</ref> This Nova-Bots{{!}}Nova-Bot can enhance his [[Temporal Field]] by sacrificing system power, and he is capable of reaching a full-power state.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c47" /> Married to [[Leilari]], he possesses eyes that can glow bright white.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c47" /> Though he operates under a disguise, he is actually a Nova-Bots{{!}}Nova-Bot who uses [[optical beams]] and fights both Varic Vallenar{{!}}Varic and [[Horizon]].<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c48">''The Engineer'', chapter 48</ref> He intends to take the narrator into custody to prevent further trouble, though he later looks at them impassively.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c48" /><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c49">''The Engineer'', chapter 49</ref> As a [[Subline]] star, he intended to execute the narrator for their crimes against the galaxy.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c49" /> He may disable [[The Last Horizon]] if the Captain fails to take control of it.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c50">''The Engineer'', chapter 50</ref> A champion designed by Mell D-One-Twenty-Five{{!}}Mell, he is able to track his designer through wishes and [[dreams]].<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c50" /> After remotely supervising the interrogation of [[Varic Vallenar]], he may still execute the narrator.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c51">''The Engineer'', chapter 51</ref> Equipped with a personal shield, this android was created by [[Doctor Nova]].<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c52">''The Engineer'', chapter 52</ref>}}

<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Imprisoned in spell-anchor}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Starhammer is currently held in imprisonment within a [[spell-anchor]].<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c55">''The Engineer'', chapter 55</ref> This confinement follows recent actions taken by the entity that have caused concern throughout the [[Union]].<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c55" />}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">2</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|[[Starhammer]] is imprisoned in a [[spell-anchor]].<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c55" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|[[Starhammer]] has recently taken actions that have caused concern within the [[Union]].<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c55" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Starhammer is a searchable entity that once assembled a fleet alongside the [[Galactic Union]] and the [[Karoshan Alliance]] to kill the narrator.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c11">''The Knight'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c15">''The Knight'', chapter 15</ref> Currently held within [[The Last Horizon]], this individual is a corrupt member of [[the Advocates]] who previously forced the [[D’Niss]] to summon both the [[Iron Legion]] and [[Esh’kinaar]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c16">''The Knight'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c26">''The Knight'', chapter 26</ref> As a powerful enemy capable of delivering heavy hits, Starhammer has been fought by Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion in the past.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c24">''The Knight'', chapter 24</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c27">''The Knight'', chapter 27</ref> When facing this entity, the fleet consisted mostly of smaller vessels supplemented by a few cruisers and carriers.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c39">''The Knight'', chapter 39</ref> The Captain has also kept Starhammer as an object.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c45">''The Knight'', chapter 45</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">9</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|[[Starhammer]] is a person or entity that can be searched for.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c11" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|[[Starhammer]] previously cobbled together a fleet with the [[Galactic Union]] and the [[Karoshan Alliance]] to kill the narrator.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c15" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|[[Starhammer]] is currently being held in [[The Last Horizon]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c16" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|[[Starhammer]] is a person who forced the [[D’Niss]] to summon [[Esh’kinaar]] and the [[Iron Legion]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c16" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|[[Starhammer]] is an enemy capable of hitting hard.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|[[Starhammer]] is a corrupt individual from [[the Advocates]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c26" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion has previously fought [[Starhammer]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c27" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The fleet's composition was primarily made up of smaller ships and a handful of carriers and cruisers when facing [[Starhammer]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c39" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|[[Starhammer]] is an object that the Captain has kept.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c45" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Starhammer once served as the leader of an allied fleet.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c3">''The Pilot'', chapter 3</ref> This being eventually spiraled out of control, resulting in the [[destruction]] of Advocate headquarters{{!}}Advocate Headquarters.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c8">''The Pilot'', chapter 8</ref> Following this catastrophe, Starhammer was sealed away within an [[Absolute Burial]] spell.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c8" /> Due to this history, [[Horizon]] refuses to speak of the individual.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c8" />}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">4</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Starhammer]] led an allied fleet.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c3" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Starhammer]] is a person [[Horizon]] refuses to talk about.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Starhammer]] is a being that went out of control and destroyed Advocate headquarters{{!}}Advocate Headquarters.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Starhammer]] was sealed in an [[Absolute Burial]] spell.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c8" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Reanimated starship}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Starhammer is a combat-engaged starship that has been experiencing madness and was once viewed as a threat to peace.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c23">''The Pilot'', chapter 23</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c26">''The Pilot'', chapter 26</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c29">''The Pilot'', chapter 29</ref> Following the vessel's [[destruction]], [[Advocate headquarters]] became a darker place.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c27">''The Pilot'', chapter 27</ref> The reanimated body of the starship, which is irreplaceable and was previously kept as a trophy, features a white skintight outfit with purple accents.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c29" /><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c30">''The Pilot'', chapter 30</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c32">''The Pilot'', chapter 32</ref> This outfit displays a seven-pointed star rather than the [[Advocate]] A.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c29" /> As a [[construct]] with inhuman eyes, Starhammer is controlled by Mell D-One-Twenty-Five{{!}}Mell, though the [[Engineer]] once attempted to dive into its body.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c46">''The Pilot'', chapter 46</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c47">''The Pilot'', chapter 47</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">12</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Starhammer]] is experiencing madness.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c23" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Starhammer]] was considered a threat to peace.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c26" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Starhammer]]'s [[destruction]] has made [[Advocate headquarters]] a darker place.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c27" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Starhammer]] wears a white skintight outfit with purple accents.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c29" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Starhammer]]'s outfit features a seven-pointed star instead of the [[Advocate]] A.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c29" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Starhammer]]'s body has been reanimated.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c29" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Starhammer]] is a starship engaged in combat.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c29" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Starhammer]]'s body is irreplaceable.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c30" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Starhammer]]'s body was kept as a trophy.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c32" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Zenith Starship]]'s [[World Spirit]] is obsessed with glorious victory.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c32" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Starhammer]] is a [[construct]] that Mell D-One-Twenty-Five{{!}}Mell controls and has inhuman eyes.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c46" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Engineer]] tried to dive in [[Starhammer]]’s body.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c47" />}}</li>
</ul></div>
